rationale: Price gapped up with no news catalyst, reversed sharply through VWAP and 9-EMA on 6x relative volume, and the most recent large-volume candle (404k shares) drove a flush to $16.34 before a partial recovery — mechanical evidence of distribution and intraday downtrend.
